name: Race rules
summary: The race itself: countdown, laps, sectors, positions, finish, car-to-car contacts, snapshots, race settings and entries (crews), and building a race from start data.
notes: Pure data, no nodes, deterministic. Damage: settings.damage_level (off/visual/full); the sim damages cars from contacts and barrier hits and emits incident / retired events (is_retired()). RaceControl owns flags, the virtual safety car, the safety car and penalties (RaceSim.add_penalty, RaceEntry.penalty_s). Pit stops and fuel rules plug in here. Car setups: settings.tuning_enabled (false = everyone on the default setup); RaceFactory.plan gives every AI car a SetupAdvisor setup for the track and copies each human's "setup"; the setup's fuel load counts when fuel is on. Per-wheel tyres: RaceSim.wheel_compounds[i] ([4]), fit_tyres(i, wheels, compound), main_compound(), mixed_tyres(i); compounds[i] is the compound on most wheels. Pit plan keys wheel_tyres ([4] choice or compound id, mixing allowed) and psi ([4] cold delta per tyre), used once then cleared; pit state compounds and psi_trim; PitRules.choice_compound, wheel_psi.
